pass_1.finding: Methods specify MspI, A-tail, standard premethylated indexed Illumina adapters and two PCR rounds but no adapter or primer bases.

pass_2.locations: gr.161679.113_PMC3847781.xml.txt lines 47, 103-109; source-bundle scraper run and its JATS pointers checked in the original Methods
pass_2.finding: The original specifies MspI C^CGG, Klenow exo-minus fill/dA tail, ligation of standard premethylated indexed Illumina adapters, bisulfite conversion, two PCR rounds and paired-end HiSeq 2000. It prints no adapter strand, selected index, PCR primer sequence or 3-prime-dT ligation end; the canonical TruSeq fork is an inference.

pass_1.finding: The missing cited Supplemental Table 5 applies to a separate nested-PCR assay; no source-backed library oligo sequence was recovered. Bulk RRBS predecessor remains unreviewed.

missing_claims.claim: Exact indexed adapter and PCR-primer identities
missing_claims.evidence: Main scRRBS Methods name generic premethylated indexed Illumina adapters and omit PCR-primer bases; historical adapter/index product choice and bulk predecessor remain unexamined.

conclusion: Two independent readings of defining article and available archives. Exact scRRBS adapter/primer claims remain blocked by unavailable publisher supplement, Gu 2011 predecessor and full 2015 detailed protocol.
